hookProtocol.scope: Top-level exact HTTPS www.youtube.com/watch with configured syntactically valid11-character public video ID; current v parameter must match. No live_chat, embedded or foreign document observation.
hookProtocol.semantics: Call original methods with Reflect.apply and original receiver/arguments first, return exactly their result and propagate their original exception. Only after a successful appendBuffer return, synchronously inspect the supplied byte view. Catch observer errors internally. Never mutate the caller buffer, delay the native append, rewrite a media request, call isTypeSupported/change quality, fetch media, use captureStream/MediaRecorder or alter the page UI.
hookProtocol.ownership: Never retain the caller's ArrayBuffer, TypedArray, DataView, subarray view or any reference to it past the synchronous wrapper. Cross-append parser state owns only bounded structural/header prefix or tail copies; no full encoded sample, complete Cluster or media append copy. Reject SharedArrayBuffer observation. Hook functions never return diagnostic data to the site.
hookProtocol.sourceBinding: WeakMaps bind the actual MediaSource and SourceBuffer objects. Local createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL observation maps the ephemeral object URL to its MediaSource without exposing or persisting the string. Snapshot determines selected by comparing current video.currentSrc to that map. Tracks expose only small source/track ordinals, generation, selected and detached flags. Never combine sources or attribute an unselected buffer to the playing video.
hookProtocol.lifecycle: sourceclose, removeSourceBuffer and changeType reset only that parser's generation and mark prior aggregate incomplete; budgets never reset. A new init inside the same buffer starts a new bounded generation. source replacement/ad state is reported, not silently treated as a continuation. pagehide/55second observation deadline closes only diagnostic observation. The root-owned native example exits by70seconds. Native app/player lifetime and login state remain unchanged.
hookProtocol.adHandling: Before processing an append, inspect only the fixed player ad-showing/ad-interrupting classes and current protected/sourceObject booleans. For protected/ad intervals, skip structural parsing and mark observation excluded. If parsing missed bytes in an already-active stream, mark that generation incomplete rather than joining pre/post-ad bytes. Only a new fully observed init may make structural completeness known again.

bounds.behavior: Use checked integer arithmetic/BigInt for EBML sizes and timestamps. Unknown-size sentinel is a type, never a huge allocation. Unknown/skipped element payload advances a remaining count without scanning/copying. Any bound or unsupported structure halts that track's parser with a fixed reason, preserves playback and reports unknown/incomplete; never converts truncation or timeout into an unsupported-codec fact or safe production admission.

webmParserProposal.incrementalState: ElementHeader (ID1..4bytes,size1..8bytes) -> bounded master stack or Scalar/PayloadSkip -> next header. Retain at most12 header bytes across appends (four ID plus eight size bytes; corrected arithmetic before QA). Unknown size is accepted structurally only for Segment/Cluster; a level1 Cluster/new EBML header closes a preceding unknown Cluster according to MSE rules. Respect known parent bounds, checked depth/length, Timestamp-before-Block and complete headers. This probe reports topology, not valid playable media.
webmParserProposal.initialization: Recognize EBML/Segment/Info/Tracks and selected TrackEntry. Project fixed DocType category webm/other, unknown Segment flag, positive TimestampScale (including specified default), video codec category VP9/other, track number/count, PixelWidth/Height, DefaultDuration, FlagLacing, bounded profile/color fields and presence of CodecPrivate/ContentEncodings. Unknown strings, UID/name/title/language/writer/date or private bytes are skipped, never logged. Encryption/compression metadata is only a presence/type enum and makes recording feasibility unproven.
webmParserProposal.clusters: Project known/unknown size count, Timestamp, SimpleBlock versus BlockGroup counts, signed16-bit relative block time, track number, lacing enum none/xiph/fixed/ebml, frame-count scalar, BlockDuration/ReferenceBlock presence and bounded resulting presentation interval/cadence numbers. Do not presume absent BlockDuration means constant frame rate. Header sizes and lacing sizes must fit the enclosing Block using checked arithmetic; oversized lacing header results in fixed limit/unknown.
webmParserProposal.vp9: For an unlaced first coded frame only, at most32 owned prefix bytes may project frame-marker validity, profile, show_existing_frame, key/inter, show_frame and key-frame sync/dimension/color scalars where wholly present. Keep at most34 owned final bytes of the containing coded payload to report a syntactically self-consistent superframe marker, frame-count and total-size match. Never claim all superframe subframe headers are validated: their earlier payload is not retained. Laced frames or unobserved prefix report unknown, not false. No raw header/index bytes leave the parser.
webmParserProposal.completeness: Snapshot separately reports complete init, complete headers/blocks, still-open unknown cluster, parser stop reason and inspected count. A legal open unknown-size Cluster at the sample deadline is not a malformed container; unparsed trailer/frame fields remain unknown. All scalar findings are feasibility evidence, never production trust inputs.

aacAndClockProposal.aac: For exact audio/mp4 AAC-LC MIME, copy only bounded ftyp+moov initialization or moof metadata within the same64KiB scratch budget, release it after projecting scalars, and skip mdat bytes without copying. Reuse the existing initTiming/moofShape concepts by narrow diagnostic copy, not production modification. Record mdhd timescale, tfhd/trun/trex duration-source category, tfdt and first/end duration sums with fixed parse-known flags. No AAC payload, ESDS/config bytes or media URL output.
aacAndClockProposal.clock: For each parsed generation expose finite segments-mode timestampOffset, appendWindowStart/End category, first/last raw source presentation seconds (bounded finite0..1e9) and up to8 recent observation-time/source-interval pairs. Display-time comparison is coded PTS plus that buffer's contemporaneous timestampOffset; record offset changes explicitly. Cross-track overlap and relative clock deltas are calculated only for the same selected MediaSource with complete known clocks. Asynchronous first appends are not presumed simultaneous and neither track is independently zeroed.
aacAndClockProposal.chat: No chat page/continuation/text is read. These scalar clocks can inform a later production design but cannot by themselves establish chat synchronization or change the existing receive-time-approximate archive proof.
